description: Reads a product page: ingredient list (allergens in capitals, possible traces), allergen statement if the site provides it, and origin. Ingredients are null for a raw product (fruit, fresh meat).

product_id.description: retailer product identifier (id field of search_products)

name: get_product

allergens.description: separate allergen statement, if the site provides it

ingredients.description: ingredient list as displayed (allergens in capitals); null for a raw product

origin.description: origin declared on the product page, if any

title: Product details
